metadata.question: On February 14, 2023, were nighttime lights in central Antakya, the capital of Türkiye’s Hatay Province, brighter than those around Hatay Airport?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use NOAA VIIRS Day/Night Band nightly lights (NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/NIGHTLY_V1/VCMSLCFG). Filter by Feb 14, 2023 and the union of two AOIs (central Antakya and Hatay Airport). If empty, try the alternate collection (VCMCFG). If still empty, widen date window (±1 day). If still empty, return C1.
2. Masking strategy: Use the product’s radiance band 'avg_rad'. Mask invalid values (<0 or >1000). No cloud mask is necessary as VCMSLCFG already reduces cloud/stray-light effects.
3. Logic for Valid Zero vs Null: Compute valid pixel counts via Reducer.count(). If either AOI has 0 valid pixels after masking, return C2. If mean is null/NaN, return C3. Otherwise compare means: Antakya > Airport => A, else B.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const antakyaCenter = ee.Geometry.Point([36.1572, 36.2066]); // lon, lat
    const airportCenter = ee.Geometry.Point([36.2822, 36.3628]);
    const antakyaAOI = antakyaCenter.buffer(3000);
    const airportAOI = airportCenter.buffer(3000);
    const unionAOI = antakyaAOI.union(airportAOI);

    const targetStart = ee.Date('2023-02-14');
    const targetEnd = ee.Date('2023-02-15');

    // 2. Helper functions
    function prepNoaa(img) {
      // Use 'avg_rad' radiance band, mask negative and extreme outliers.
      const rad = img.select('avg_rad');
      return rad.updateMask(rad.gte(0)).updateMask(rad.lte(1000)).rename('ntl')
                 .copyProperties(img, img.propertyNames());
    }
    function addDateDiff(ic, targetDate) {
      return ic.map(function(img) {
        const diff = img.date().difference(targetDate, 'day').abs();
        return img.set('diff_days', diff);
      });
    }
    async function getBestImage(collectionId, start, end, fallbackWindowDays) {
      let col = ee.ImageCollection(collectionId)
        .filterDate(start, end)
        .filterBounds(unionAOI)
        .select('avg_rad');
      let size = await col.size().getInfo();
      if (size === 0 && fallbackWindowDays > 0) {
        const start2 = ee.Date(start).advance(-fallbackWindowDays, 'day');
        const end2 = ee.Date(end).advance(fallbackWindowDays, 'day');
        col = ee.ImageCollection(collectionId)
          .filterDate(start2, end2)
          .filterBounds(unionAOI)
          .select('avg_rad');
        size = await col.size().getInfo();
      }
      if (size === 0) return {img: null, size: 0};
      // Pick image closest to target date
      const colWithDiff = addDateDiff(col, targetStart);
      const best = ee.Image(colWithDiff.sort('diff_days').first());
      return {img: best, size: size};
    }

    async function summarize(img, geom, scale) {
      const masked = prepNoaa(img);
      const count = await masked.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: geom,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('ntl').getInfo();
      if (!count || count === 0) {
        return {count: 0, mean: null};
      }
      const mean = await masked.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry: geom,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('ntl').getInfo();
      return {count: count, mean: mean};
    }

    // 3. Data Acquisition & Check with fallback logic
    const primaryId = 'NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/NIGHTLY_V1/VCMSLCFG';
    const altId = 'NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/NIGHTLY_V1/VCMCFG';
    let datasetIdUsed = null;
    let best = await getBestImage(primaryId, targetStart, targetEnd, 0);
    if (best.size === 0) {
      // Try alternate NOAA nightly
      best = await getBestImage(altId, targetStart, targetEnd, 0);
      if (best.size === 0) {
        // Widen date window ±1 day for both
        best = await getBestImage(primaryId, targetStart, targetEnd, 1);
        if (best.size === 0) {
          best = await getBestImage(altId, targetStart, targetEnd, 1);
        }
      }
      datasetIdUsed = (best && best.img) ? altId : null;
    } else {
      datasetIdUsed = primaryId;
    }

    if (!best || !best.img) {
      console.log('Images: 0 (No nightly VIIRS found near 2023-02-14)');
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    const img = best.img;
    const imgDate = await ee.Date(img.get('system:time_start')).format('YYYY-MM-dd').getInfo();
    const scale = 1000;

    // 4. Processing and Stats
    const antStats = await summarize(img, antakyaAOI, scale);
    const airStats = await summarize(img, airportAOI, scale);

    console.log(`Using: ${datasetIdUsed} | ImgDate: ${imgDate} | CollSize: ${best.size}`);
    console.log(`Antakya px: ${antStats.count} mean: ${antStats.mean !== null ? antStats.mean.toFixed(3) : 'null'}`);
    console.log(`Airport px: ${airStats.count} mean: ${airStats.mean !== null ? airStats.mean.toFixed(3) : 'null'}`);

    // 5. Validation & Final Answer
    if ((antStats.count === 0) || (airStats.count === 0)) {
      console.log('Valid px insufficient after masking.');
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }
    if (antStats.mean === null || airStats.mean === null || !isFinite(antStats.mean) || !isFinite(airStats.mean)) {
      console.log('Calculation invalid (mean is null/NaN).');
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    const diff = antStats.mean - airStats.mean;
    const ratio = (airStats.mean !== 0) ? (antStats.mean / airStats.mean) : null;
    console.log(`Diff(Ant-Air): ${diff.toFixed(3)} | Ratio: ${ratio !== null && isFinite(ratio) ? ratio.toFixed(3) : 'inf'}`);

    if (diff > 0) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err.message || err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
